question: What is the value of 9 × 121 + 11 × 84 ÷ 4?
solution:
**Given:**

The expression 9 × 121 + 11 × 84 ÷ 4

**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7a20e61846c6ccd67207a3bc8b140be1db7470dc5524d0e4aa6bcd15a3ce09.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ 9 × 121 + 11 × 84 ÷ 4

⇒ 9 × 121 + 11 × 21

⇒ 1089 + 231

⇒ 1320

**∴ The required result will be 1320.**
